error.appointment.conflict: This provider already has an appointment during that time. Choose another available time.
error.appointment.outsideAvailability: That time is outside the provider’s availability at this location. Choose an available time.
error.appointment.providerUnavailable: This provider is unavailable at this location or time. Check the provider’s assignment and availability before choosing another time.
error.appointment.closed: This appointment is completed, cancelled or marked as a no-show and cannot be changed here. Review its history before scheduling another visit.
error.appointment.unavailable: This appointment is unavailable for this action. Refresh the schedule and check its current status.
error.appointment.invalidTransition: That change is not allowed from the appointment’s current status. Refresh the visit and choose an available next step.
error.appointment.interval: Choose a valid start and end time. The appointment must end after it starts and last no more than 24 hours.
error.appointment.visitTypeInactive: This visit type is inactive. Choose an active visit type before saving.
error.appointment.patientImmutable: An appointment’s patient cannot be changed. Cancel the incorrect appointment and schedule the correct patient if needed.
error.patient.archived: This patient is archived. Restore the patient record before scheduling a visit or creating a request.
error.concurrency.recordChanged: This record changed while you were working. Refresh it, review the latest version and apply your changes again.
error.concurrency.reviewChanged: A newer review is already recorded. Refresh the document and base any correction on the latest review.
error.concurrency.refreshRequired: Reopen this record to get its current version before saving your change.
error.save.attemptReused: This save attempt was already used with different details. Check the existing result before starting a new attempt.
error.save.attemptRequired: This form could not identify the save attempt. Reopen the form before submitting it again.
error.save.reconciliationRequired: An earlier save needs to be reviewed before another write can be made. Check existing records and contact your administrator.
error.requirement.retired: This visit requirement has been retired and cannot be changed. Refresh the visit checklist.
error.requirement.notActive: This requirement is not active. Refresh the checklist and review its waiver or retirement status before adding evidence.
error.requirement.invalidTransition: The waiver cannot be changed from its current state. Refresh the requirement and check whether a waiver is already active.
error.requirement.confirmApply: Confirm that the updated rules should be applied to this visit before continuing.
error.document.reviewRequired: This document needs an accepted review before it can satisfy the visit requirement.
error.document.signatureRequired: This requirement needs a completed signature. Request a signature or select an eligible signed document.
error.document.archived: This document is archived. Restore it before using it for this action.
error.document.expired: This document is too old for the visit’s rules. Collect or prepare a current document.
error.document.reuseForbidden: The visit’s rules do not allow this document to be reused here. Collect or prepare a document for this visit.
error.document.notCurrent: This is not the current document version. Refresh the document and select the current version.
error.document.unavailable: This document is not ready or available for this action. Check its processing and archive status before continuing.
error.document.invalidTransition: The document is already in that archive state. Refresh it to check its current status.
error.document.immutable: This saved file cannot be overwritten. Keep its existing version and create a new version for new content.
error.template.publishedImmutable: A published template version cannot be edited. Create a new draft version for your changes.
error.template.typeImmutable: A template’s document type cannot be changed. Create a separate template for the other document type.
error.template.notPublished: Publish an active template version before preparing a document from it.
error.template.versionUnavailable: This template version is not available for publication. Refresh the template and choose an eligible version.
error.template.versionMismatch: The document does not use the template version required for this visit. Prepare it from the required version.
error.request.closed: This request is closed. Review its result or create a new request if more information is needed.
error.request.reminderCooldown: A reminder was attempted recently. Wait before sending another reminder and check the delivery status.
error.request.linkUnavailable: This secure link has expired, been closed or is unavailable. Ask your care team for a new link.
error.request.itemUnavailable: This requested item is no longer available through this link. Ask your care team to check the request.
error.request.collectionRequired: This request does not accept document uploads. Follow the action shown in the request or contact your care team.
error.request.signatureRequired: This request does not accept a signature. Follow the action shown in the request or contact your care team.
error.request.deliveryUnavailable: This request was not delivered. Delivery is unavailable; review its status and contact your administrator before relying on it.
error.upload.expired: This upload session has expired. Start a new upload with the file you want to submit.
error.upload.integrity: The uploaded file does not match the reserved file. Select the original file and start a new upload.
error.upload.notReceived: The file has not been received yet. Finish transferring it before completing the upload.
error.upload.alreadyCompleted: This upload has already completed. Check its document and processing result before starting another upload.
error.upload.unavailable: This upload is unavailable through the current session. Refresh the request or start a new upload if it is still open.
error.upload.fileType: Choose a valid PDF, PNG or JPEG file no larger than 10 MB.
error.upload.scannerUnavailable: The file could not be safety-checked and remains unavailable for use. Contact your administrator to restore scanning.
error.upload.unsafeFile: The safety scan rejected this file. It is unavailable for review or signing. Ask for a safe replacement file.
error.document.integrityUnavailable: The stored file could not be verified and was not opened. Contact your administrator before using this document.
error.signature.closed: This signing session has already been completed or closed. Review the request status or ask your care team for a new request.
error.signature.sourceChanged: The document to be signed changed or could not be verified. Do not sign this version; ask your care team for a new request.
error.signature.sourceUnavailable: The source document is not available for signing. Prepare a ready PDF before sending a signature request.
error.signature.consentRequired: Read the displayed consent and confirm your agreement before submitting your signature.
error.signature.fieldRequired: Complete every required signature field before submitting.
error.signature.invalidFields: Check the signature fields and draw or type your signature again. Your signature has not been accepted.
error.work.closed: This work item is already closed. Refresh the work queue to check its result.
error.work.requirementFirst: Complete the document collection, replacement or review first. This work item closes when the related action is completed.
error.access.locationRequired: Choose a working location before opening records or saving changes.
error.access.locationDenied: Your access to this location could not be confirmed. Refresh access or ask your practice owner to review your assignments.
error.access.authentication: Your session has expired or could not be confirmed. Sign in again to continue.
error.access.forbidden: Your current permissions do not allow this action. Ask your practice owner to review your access.
error.access.accountUnavailable: This account is unavailable. Use another account or contact your CareIQ administrator.
error.access.verificationUnavailable: Your current account access could not be verified. Wait a moment and try again.
error.access.enrollmentRequired: Your practice membership is not ready for this action. Ask the practice owner to confirm your role and locations.
error.access.enrollmentReview: Your membership needs an updated access review. Ask your practice owner to confirm your current role and locations.
error.access.suspended: Your access to this practice is suspended. Contact the practice owner before continuing.
error.access.alreadyActive: Your membership is already active. Refresh access to open your practice.
error.access.ownerRequired: This action requires the practice owner’s administrator access. Ask the practice owner to make this change.
error.access.transferRequired: Transfer practice ownership to an eligible administrator before changing the owner’s access.
error.access.selfRoleChange: You cannot change your own role here. Ask another authorized administrator to review your role.
error.access.roleNotAllowed: Choose a role approved for this practice.
error.access.roleUpdatePending: The role update is waiting for confirmation. Refresh access before making another change.
error.access.suspendMember: Use Suspend access to remove this member’s access instead of confirming an empty assignment.
error.setup.verifyEmail: Verify your account email before setting up a practice.
error.setup.notEligible: This account is not approved to create a practice. Use a team invitation or contact your CareIQ administrator.
error.setup.inProgress: Practice setup has already started. Check the original setup status using the same details.
error.setup.complete: Your practice has already been created. Open your practice to continue.
error.setup.retryConflict: This setup attempt uses different details from the original submission. Resume the original setup before creating another practice.
error.setup.unavailable: The practice operation could not be confirmed. Check its status or retry the same attempt with the same details.
error.access.clientUpdateRequired: This practice needs an updated client or setup. Contact your administrator before opening its records.
error.access.practiceUnavailable: This practice is unavailable. Choose another practice or contact its owner.
error.record.unavailable: This record is unavailable in your current access. Refresh the page or contact your practice owner.
error.record.scopeMismatch: These selected records cannot be used together in this location. Reopen them from the current patient and visit.
error.invitation.acceptFirst: Accept the invitation sent to your verified email before joining this practice.
error.invitation.alreadyPending: An invitation is already pending. Check the existing invitation before sending another.
error.invitation.unavailable: This invitation is unavailable or no longer valid. Ask the practice owner to check it or send a new invitation.
error.invitation.confirmationRequired: The invitation’s delivery outcome needs confirmation. Check the same invitation before attempting a new send.
error.invitation.revocationPending: Invitation revocation is waiting for provider confirmation. Retry revocation on the same invitation to check its status.
error.access.directoryLimit: This administrative directory is too large for the current view. Contact your administrator for a supported directory review.
error.audit.permission: Detailed audit history requires explicit audit permission. Ask your administrator to review your access.
error.audit.evidencePermission: Database evidence requires an additional permission. Clear that option to review standard audit history, or request access.
error.audit.purposeRequired: Enter a purpose or case reference of 3 to 96 characters before accessing audit history.
error.audit.unavailable: Protected audit access is unavailable. Contact your administrator to restore the audit service.
error.audit.exportExpired: This protected export has expired. Prepare a new export from the current audit search.
error.audit.exportScope: This export is unavailable in your current access context. Review your location access before preparing another export.
error.audit.tooLarge: This audit result is too large to export or inspect here. Narrow the date range or action filter and try again.
error.audit.invalidRange: Choose an audit period of at most 31 days with a valid start and end time in UTC.
error.pagination.cursor: This page link is no longer valid for the current filters or access. Start the search again.
error.pagination.limit: Choose a supported page size and load the list again.
error.validation.filters: Check the search filters and try again.
error.pagination.historyParent: Open a document or template before viewing its version history.
error.validation.record: The selected record reference is invalid. Reopen the record from its list.
error.validation.date: Choose a valid date and time, including the correct time zone.
error.validation.timeZone: Choose a valid time zone for this location.
error.validation.assignee: Choose an active team member assigned to this location.
error.validation.availability: Check the provider’s hours, date range and availability exceptions. Each end time must be after its start time.
error.validation.requestExpiry: Choose a future expiry at or after the request’s due date.
error.validation.requestItems: Select valid document types and active requirements for this patient and visit.
error.validation.delivery: Choose a supported delivery option and provide the matching recipient contact details.
error.validation.templateFields: Check the template fields, unique field keys and supported field types before saving.
error.validation.answers: Check the document answers and complete each field using the required format and available options.
error.validation.required: Complete all required fields before continuing.
error.validation.rules: Check the requirement rules, due dates, document age and reuse settings before publishing.
error.validation.review: Choose a supported review decision and provide a reason when required.
error.validation.owner: Choose another active administrator as the new practice owner.
error.validation.location: Check the location name and select active locations in the current practice.
error.validation.address: Check the address and keep it within 500 characters.
error.validation.setup: Check the saved practice and location details before continuing setup.
error.validation.tooLarge: The submitted information is too large. Reduce its size before trying again.
error.validation.general: Check the form details and use the supported submission format before trying again.
error.access.originDenied: This page cannot submit that request. Reopen CareIQ from its usual address.
error.interview.unavailable: Your interview request could not be confirmed. Try again later or contact your CareIQ administrator.
error.system.rateLimited: Too many attempts were made. Wait a little before trying again.
error.system.unavailable: The operation could not be confirmed. {retry}
error.save.reviewRequired: An earlier operation needs review before continuing. Check its status with your administrator.
error.system.clientUpdate: This action is not available in the current application version. Reopen the app or contact your administrator.
error.system.integrationUnavailable: This integration is unavailable. Contact your administrator to check its configuration.
error.auth.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect. Try again.
error.auth.invalidCode: That code is incorrect. Check it and try again.
error.auth.verificationExpired: That verification step has expired. Request a new code or start again.
error.auth.verificationFailed: We couldn’t verify that code. Request a new one and try again.
error.auth.compromisedPassword: Choose a different password. This one has appeared in a data breach.
error.auth.strongerPassword: Choose a stronger password that meets your account requirements.
error.auth.accountExists: An account may already use this email. Sign in or reset your password.
error.auth.invalidInformation: Check the information you entered and try again.
error.auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a little before trying again.
error.auth.alreadySignedIn: An account is already signed in. Continue with it or use another account.
error.validation.duration: Choose a whole-number duration from 1 to 1,440 minutes.
error.validation.appointment: Choose a patient and a valid appointment date and time.
